newsitem.title: INDIA: India call seen at 6-7 pct next fortnight-SBI Caps.
newsitem.headline: India call seen at 6-7 pct next fortnight-SBI Caps.

text.p: Strong funds inflows in the next two weeks will keep Indian call money rates in a narrow range, SBI Capital Markets (SBI Caps) said in a debt market report on Monday.
"Call money rates are expected to range around 6-7 percent," it said.
It said securities worth 53.95 billion rupees mature for payment along with interest payments of 2.95 billion rupees in the next fortnight.
"The large redemptions indicate a medium-term government of India stock auction in the second week of the coming fortnight," the report said.
SBI Capital Markets said it does not expect the liquidity position to change significantly as funds invested in repo auctions and in 14-day treasury bills will provide a buffer.
The report said primary yields on treasury bills might not change much but expected secondary market trades to pick up.
